mentions.name: Next Arc Research
mentions.description: A weekly machine-assisted investment research project that runs analyses on 120+ public companies across semiconductors, cloud, biotech, energy, robotics, quantum, and crypto. It combines large-model reasoning (GPT-5+, also tested with Sonnet, Gemini, and Grok) with structured scoring across technology maturity, risk, competitive positioning, and alignment to AI-era dynamics, inspired by Emad Mostaque's "The Last Economy" thesis. Output is static HTML dashboards, PDFs, and CSVs that track month-over-month shifts, updated weekly, with free example output on the site and paid tiers via Patreon to scale coverage.
mentions.problem: Answering how AI, compute, and capital might change markets by 2030 — which companies are structurally positioned for outsized upside in The Last Economy, and what signals would help identify "the next NVIDIA" 5 years earlier.
mentions.audience: Originally built for the author's own use and retail investors in his family; now polished for broader general utility.
